thread.title: Tax Reform's Impact on the Economy

title: Tax Reform's Impact on the Economy
text:
Tax Reform's Impact on the Economy By Bret Jensen | Jan 24, 2018 | 1:00 PM EST 
In Monday's column we discussed how recently passed tax reform is already positively impacting the economy, highlighting Action Alerts PLUS holding Apple's (AAPL) announced decision that it's investing $350 billion in the United States over the next five years. 
Since that article other announcements have been made to further support that thesis. Action Alerts PLUS holding JP Morgan Chase (JPM) just stated that it plans to take $20 billion of capital over the next five years and allocate it to raising wages, boosting its U.S. staff, increasing loans for affordable housing, and lifting charitable donations. The minimum wage at the bank will also go up substantially. In addition, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) announced it was lifting its projection for worldwide growth .2% to 3.9%. It cited the impacts of U.S. tax reform as the reason for the revision before the organization headed off to the 'champagne and caviar' meetings, also known as Davos....449
